---
title: "Set up IntroStatGPT with Claude Code"
description: "Install R and open an IntroStatGPT assignment in Claude Code"
---

The IntroStatGPT assignment folder contains the instructions and tools Claude
Code needs. The assignment, data, saved output, and report files stay together
in that folder.

The standard course setup uses Codex with your UT ChatGPT account. Follow this
page if you already have a Claude account with access to Claude Code.

## Before you begin

You need:

- [R](https://cloud.r-project.org/) installed on your computer;
- the Claude desktop app; and
- a Claude account with access to the **Code** tab.

Claude Code on desktop requires a Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise subscription.
See Anthropic's [Claude Code desktop setup](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop-quickstart)
for the current download and account requirements. On Windows, install
[Git for Windows](https://git-scm.com/downloads/win) before starting a local
Code session.

## 1. Download and extract the assignment

For Homework 1, download
[IntroStatGPT_homework_01_2026-08-28.zip](../files/IntroStatGPT_homework_01_2026-08-28.zip).
Extract it and move the resulting folder to Documents.

Keep the folder's files and subfolders in their original locations. Work from
the extracted folder rather than from the ZIP file.

## 2. Open the assignment in Claude Code

1. Open the Claude desktop app and sign in.
2. Select the **Code** tab.
3. Select **Local**.
4. Select **Select folder** and choose the extracted IntroStatGPT assignment
   folder.
5. Start a new session in that folder.

Use **Local** so Claude can run R and work with the assignment files on your
computer.

## 3. Set up the assignment

Send:

> Set up this IntroStatGPT workspace and verify that it is ready. Do not begin
> an analysis yet.

Claude checks R, the required packages, and the assignment data. If packages
are missing, it asks for permission before installing them. Approve the
installation when the request lists the required R packages and says they will
be installed in your personal R library.

Setup is complete when Claude reports that the assignment data and required R
packages are ready.

## 4. Complete the assignment

For each **Generate output** panel:

1. Start a new session in the same assignment folder.
2. Ask for the data, variables, table, plot, labels, and other specifications
   named in the panel.
3. Review the output in the conversation and on the analysis page.
4. Ask for a specific correction when something is missing or hard to read.
5. Answer the assignment questions in your own words.

Claude may ask for permission before running R or writing analysis files.
Approve a request when it matches the setup or statistical output you asked it
to create.

## 5. Build the Word report

After generating the required output, ask Claude to create the assignment
report. Identify the outputs by their P and T labels and state the report
headings and order required by the assignment.

Claude shows the proposed report outline in the conversation. Review the
headings, included outputs, and order. Describe any changes, then approve the
outline and ask Claude to build the Word report.

Download the Word report from the link Claude provides. Add your written
answers in Word, export the completed document to PDF, and submit the PDF.

## Troubleshooting

### The Code tab asks you to upgrade

Your Claude account does not currently include Claude Code. Use Codex or the
backup report skeleton supplied with the assignment.

### Claude cannot find R

Close and reopen the Claude desktop app after installing R. Reopen the
assignment folder and send:

> Check whether R is installed and available to this workspace.

### Claude cannot find the assignment

Confirm that the selected project is the extracted IntroStatGPT folder itself,
not the ZIP file, a CSV file, or one of the folder's subdirectories.

### You reopen the assignment later

Select the same extracted folder in the **Code** tab. Saved tables, plots, and
reports remain in that folder and are available in a new session.
